rule_or_pattern: Drop full-width lines whose label is too short for the crop: width_ratio > 0.9 AND cpp_vs_book < 0.8 (letter-spaced headings/signatures are narrower and stay). Keep the rest; the duplicate page shared with vouli 452f5a742630 is left to the pool-wide dedup.
notes: 1852 Senate minutes, polytonic, single column; most labels match the print (1-13, 16, 18-40) and page p006 is a clean duplicate of a page in book 452f5a742630. On page p003 several full-width crops carry labels missing the start of the line: 14 shows 'Ἐκ τῆς σημειώσεως ταύτης ἐξάγεται, ὅτι τὰ πραγματικὰ' but the label is ', ὑπερέβησαν'; 15 drops the leading '5267,'; 17 drops the leading 'ἀνάγκη, ὡς'. These have cpp_vs_book 0.22-0.76 at width ~0.95, which separates them from the correctly read letter-spaced lines 22/23/33. Also seen once: στ ligature read as σ ('σρατοδικείων', 2), which the pool ς→στ rule will not catch.
